findings.problem: Bearer parsing required exact capitalization/single-space prefix, rejecting valid scheme casing and multiple-space forms; protected 401 replies omitted the authentication challenge.
findings.change: Case-insensitive scheme matching with ASCII space separation and bearer-token character grammar; retain token bytes/JWT verification. Add static Bearer realm=api challenge for required-auth/unauthenticated role 401 replies.

references.supports: Bearer header credentials use one or more SP separators and b64token syntax.
Protected-resource missing/invalid bearer credentials require WWW-Authenticate.

findings.limit: This addresses selected transport requirements, not complete OAuth/TLS/deployment conformance.

findings.problem: requireRole closed over the mutable caller array and exported role tuples were mutable at runtime, permitting application code to alter later policy behavior.
findings.change: Capture a policy snapshot, accept readonly role lists, freeze exported catalogs and preset object, reuse ADMIN_ONLY for requireAdmin. Existing role memberships/case sensitivity unchanged.
findings.limit: Synthetic application-state mutation reproducer; no unauthenticated client capability or production mutation caller was demonstrated.

findings.problem: Duplicated plugin/shared/ambient request identity types drifted: sessionId existed on plugin payload but not shared/ambient user; readonly exported role lists were rejected by role utility signatures.
findings.change: One shared JWTPayload including optional sessionId, compatible plugin type export and AuthenticatedUser alias; ambient request user is that same type or null. Readonly policy/query parameters accepted.

initial_cold_attempt.resolution: Initial cold Fastify setup exceeded the default five-second case budget (about 7401ms). Definitive before/after focused runs use explicit --testTimeout=15000; final complete unit run uses unchanged defaults.

review.dependency_reads: Complete auth plugin, JWT service/port and in-memory blacklist, actual server plugin ordering and representative order staff/ownership controller read. Selected cart/checkout optional-hook sections and static role/optional-auth callers traced. Not a complete module/route/blacklist review.
review.preserved_security: Existing HS256 verification, access/refresh/pending-token separation, schema/expiry checks, blacklist enforcement and current-session query remain in place. No roles, account-status policy, secrets or token expiry settings changed.
review.session_query: Inert Prisma tests assert sessionId/userId/isRevoked=false/expiresAt>now/active-user/current-role filter and requery per request. Missing rows reject required auth or become anonymous under optional auth; persistence exceptions remain redacted 500 responses. This does not prove real SQL/model behavior.
review.deduplication: Central numeric-401 classifier used by required/optional middleware and early rate-limit authentication. Only credential rejections can downgrade; infrastructure errors propagate. One identity declaration replaces drifted parallel shapes.
review.scope: Realm challenge static; no credential/token values placed in headers or errors. Unknown roles/missing identity remain denied; optional public routes retain anonymous behavior.

verification.coverage_scope: Only auth plugin, required/optional/role middleware and shared auth HTTP helper: 62 lines, 68 statements, 11 functions, 32 branches at 100%. No full rate-limiter, JWT-service, blacklist, endpoint, DB or whole-backend coverage claim.
verification.role_matrix: Five presets x six supported roles = 30 independently expected allow/deny cases using actual signed JWT/plugin/hooks and inert persistence. Additional missing/unknown/lowercase roles, caller-list mutation, five catalog mutations and helper/alias checks.
verification.token_matrix: Valid scheme variants; missing/malformed headers and challenge; refresh/pending/expired/wrong-key/wrong-algorithm/malformed-claim/sessionless/blacklisted tokens; request isolation, null session transitions, DB exceptions, no-config failure, configured secret/default signing and existing no-Prisma verifier compatibility.

open_followups.scope: Protected and optional route/model state checks still require owned PostgreSQL HTTP tests for revocation/expiry/account/role changes and outages. Inert query/result checks do not close those strict gates or all registered endpoint policies.

AuthenticatedRequest still defaults its route generic to any. Broader body/query/params typing requires tracing/migrating actual route/controller contracts; identity metadata correction is not that migration.
Detailed rate-limit key/store/window/configuration/memory/lifecycle review is next; this task only reused the shared unauthorized classifier there.

In-memory blacklist/restart/multi-instance behavior and no-Prisma verifier compatibility remain explicit. Production server statically registers DB before auth; full bootstrap/deployment/session lifecycle and owning module authorization remain open.

limits: No live/real DB or provider execution; prior PostgreSQL 47-group baseline remains historical. No data/schema/token-format/secret migrations.
HTTP tests mount synthetic routes with actual hooks/plugin and inert Prisma; no full endpoint-prefix/role/ownership matrix certification.
Role immutability is an internal policy construction invariant; it is not claimed as an externally exploitable privilege-escalation finding.
Signature/claim checks are exercised as dependencies, not a complete JWT/blacklist/authentication-service review. Token-state durability is not added.
Only helper/ambient-type/two fixture files close; middleware/plugin remain open for real-DB/composition gates and request interface remains open for generic typing. P01 remains open.
